item.title: My OSCP Journey - Tips, Tricks and Cheat Sheets
item.description: Welcome! I’m excited to introduce a project I’ve been working on during my preparation for the Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) certification. On my GitBook, you’ll find: Detailed cheatsheets covering penetration testing methodologies. Useful commands and quick references. Lessons learned and practical tips from my OSCP journey. The goal is to provide a resource for anyone aiming to tackle and successfully pass this prestigious ethical hacking certification.
